key_terms.حَقَّ: To become due, binding, or certain

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says 'The sentence of our Lord has come true for us'?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah As-Saffat, this verse (37:18) serves as the divine response to the disbelievers' claim that they would not be resurrected, affirming that Allah's decree is absolute and inescapable. Shia exegesis highlights the transition from the general promise of resurrection to the specific, experiential reality of 'tasting' (dhawq) the consequences of one's faith or disbelief, underscoring the immediacy of divine justice.
